name: TERAX AI Assistant
author: teraxsolution23

sections.description:
• Answers only from your own pages, posts and extra FAQ text – no invented facts.
  • Works with Claude, GPT, Gemini, Mistral or any OpenAI-compatible model.
  • “Book appointment” button that opens your Dr. Flex, Doctolib, Calendly or other booking page.
  • Built for medical and dental practices: no diagnoses, urgent cases are directed to the phone / 112.
  • GDPR: consent notice, no stored IP addresses, automatic deletion after N days, logging can be disabled.
  • Lightweight widget (~10 KB) that does not conflict with your theme.

External services

The plugin works with the content of your own website. It connects to other services only when you set it up to do so, and it sends nothing to a TERAX server.

AI provider (required to get answers)

Each time a visitor sends a message in the chat, your server sends it to the AI provider you selected under AI Assistant > Settings > AI model, so the provider can write the answer. The chat only starts after the visitor has accepted your privacy notice.

Data sent: the visitor’s question, up to ten earlier messages of the same chat, text excerpts from your own pages that match the question, the assistant’s instructions, and your API key (in the request header). The visitor’s IP address is not sent.

You choose one provider:

  • Anthropic (Claude), https://api.anthropic.com: Terms, Privacy policy
  • OpenAI (GPT), https://api.openai.com: Terms, Privacy policy
  • Google (Gemini), https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com: Terms, Privacy policy
  • Mistral AI, https://api.mistral.ai: Terms and privacy policy
  • Any OpenAI-compatible service at an address you enter (for example Groq, or a server of your own): the terms of that service apply.

Appointment booking

The “Book appointment” button is an ordinary link to the booking page you enter (for example Doctolib, Dr. Flex or Calendly). Visitors only leave your site if they click it. The plugin sends nothing to those services.

Source code

The admin screens and the chat widget are built with Vite and React (admin) and Preact (chat widget). The compressed files are in assets/admin/dist and assets/frontend/dist; the readable source is in the public repository https://github.com/TERAX-Solution/terax-ai-chatbot-public (folder src/). To build them yourself: npm ci and npm run build.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP under Plugins → Add New → Upload, then activate.
  2. Go to AI Assistant → Settings → AI model and add your API key.
  3. Add your booking link under Settings → Booking.
  4. Check AI Assistant → Knowledge – your pages are indexed automatically.

Shortcode for an inline chat: [terax_ai_chat height=”560″]
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Added: Answers appear while they are being written instead of after a wait of several seconds (Anthropic, OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible providers); the setting “Stream answers” turns it off for hosts that hold back live responses
  • Removed: Sales mode with the lead form, call-back requests with the Requests page, the Insights report and custom AI instructions leave this plugin: WordPress.org hosts only free, fully working features. They return in the separate paid add-on “TERAX AI Assistant Pro”
  • Removed: Managed AI, the license page, upgrade pop-ups and all locked or “(upgrade)” buttons in the admin, and the plan limits shown in the admin
  • Changed: The script behind the “AI keeps failing” notice in the admin is loaded the WordPress way instead of being printed into the page
  • Changed: The plugin no longer loads or ships its own German .po/.mo files; translations of the plugin texts come from translate.wordpress.org once the plugin is listed there (the admin screens keep their built-in German)

1.1.1

  • The plugin page lists the correct WordPress.org contributor account

1.1.0

  • Added: Insights page: questions the assistant could not answer, grouped by topic, with an “Add answer” shortcut to the Knowledge page; the Dashboard shows the answer rate
  • Added: Call-back requests: a form in the chat when the assistant cannot answer, and a Requests page in the admin
  • Added: Sales mode with a lead form for sites that are not medical practices
  • Added: First-run setup wizard (AI connection, booking link, build the knowledge index)
  • Added: Notice in the admin and an e-mail to the site admin when the AI provider keeps failing
  • Added: CSV export of conversations with a choice of separator for German or US Excel
  • Changed: The Pro upgrade hint in the admin is now a single animated line on the Dashboard that can be dismissed, instead of a large banner on every page
  • Changed: The free plugin no longer limits messages, indexed pages or log retention, and the “Powered by TERAX” link in the chat is off until you turn it on in the settings
  • Changed: The admin hides the License page unless the Pro add-on is active
  • Changed: The paid features (licence, Managed AI, sales mode, call-back requests, custom instructions, insights) now come from the separate “TERAX AI Assistant Pro” add-on; the free plugin has no licence code and sends nothing to TERAX servers
  • Changed: The admin loads faster: its script is split per page (about 216 KB down to 91 KB gzip)
  • Changed: The admin uses the React that WordPress already loads instead of its own copy, so its main script is about half the size (47 KB instead of 91 KB gzip) and keeps working when WordPress updates React
  • Changed: Questions in German now find content written in English, and the other way round
  • Changed: An API key that cannot be decrypted (changed salt, moved site) is no longer sent to the AI vendor; the admin asks to enter the key again
  • Fixed: The Conversations, Requests and Insights pages were blank on sites with plain permalinks
  • Fixed: A page added to the excluded pages stayed searchable until the next index rebuild
  • Fixed: A link label could be replaced in the middle of a sentence
  • Fixed: Pages built with Divi, WPBakery or Avada lost all their text in the knowledge index; the text and the accordion titles are now indexed

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
